features.note: the solid grip below the bore floor: a full 38 mm circle
the wall left around the bore and its two rail slots
the crown face, which is what the part is printed on

rationale: a straight-walled sleeve, bored to the engagement length and keyed by two opposed rail slots. Every stated expectation is the closed form of a circle or of a circle less an annulus and two rectangles, so none of them is a number read off the mesh being judged.
